name: QwenPaw
description: Runs a self-hosted personal assistant that answers on DingTalk, Lark, WeChat, Discord, Telegram and more, with layered memory, skills, cron jobs, a sandbox and optional local models.

skills.name: Multi-Channel Chat
skills.description: Serves one assistant instance across DingTalk, Lark, WeChat, Discord, Telegram, iMessage and QQ, plus a web console, TUI and desktop app.

skills.name: Layered Memory
skills.description: Keeps live working context, full verbatim history and a self-evolving Markdown knowledge base built on ReMe across conversations.

skills.name: Scheduled Tasks
skills.description: Sets up recurring jobs such as news digests, report generation and multi-channel broadcasts through QwenPaw's cron configuration.

skills.name: Local Models
skills.description: Runs QwenPaw-Flash 2B, 4B or 9B models in the built-in llama.cpp runtime, or Ollama and LM Studio, with no API key needed.
